questions.q: What two executables does a precedence constraint link?
options: The precedence executable (runs first) and the constrained executable (runs after)
The parent package and the child package
Two connection managers
A container and its enumerator
questions.explain: A precedence constraint always connects a precedence executable, which runs first, to a constrained executable, whose ability to run may depend on the outcome.

questions.q: What color does SSIS Designer use for a Failure constraint?
options: Red
Green
Blue
Yellow
questions.explain: Success is green, Failure is red, and Completion is blue — the three constraint values SSIS Designer color-codes on the connector line.

questions.q: Using the Expression and Constraint evaluation operation with a Success constraint and expression @X >= @Z, when does the constrained task run?
options: Only when the precedence task succeeds AND the expression evaluates to true
Whenever either condition is true, regardless of the other
Only when the expression is true, ignoring the constraint entirely
Only when the precedence task fails
questions.explain: Expression and Constraint requires both conditions — the constraint's execution-result requirement and the expression's Boolean result — to be true for the constrained task to run.

questions.q: If task D has three incoming precedence constraints set to Logical AND, what has to happen for D to run?
options: All three incoming constraints must evaluate to true
Only one of the three constraints needs to be true
Exactly two of the three must be true
None of them matter — D always runs regardless
questions.explain: Logical AND requires every incoming precedence constraint on the same executable to evaluate to true before the constrained executable runs. Logical OR would require only one.

questions.q: Where do you change the default constraint value SSIS Designer applies to a brand-new connector?
options: Tools → Options → Business Intelligence Designers → Integration Services Designers → Control Flow Auto Connect
The Precedence Constraint Editor's Test button
The package's Properties window, under Deployment
It cannot be changed — Success is always the default
questions.explain: SSIS Designer defaults new connectors to Success, but that default can be changed to Failure or Completion in the Control Flow Auto Connect options.
